thread:
jess (sales): FYI — Helio wants a quick POC (36h). Ask: small dedicated pool (5 reserve GPUs), ability to spike to 13 GPUs during two 1hr demo blocks daily, rotated hosted API key limited to the demo domain, and either IP allowlist or VPC peering. Need feasibility + rough cost.

kai (solutions): Which model & seq lengths? public demo? latency SLO?

jess (sales): Model: redwood-14b-quant, seq ~768 typical, occasional 1500. Public demo for partner showcase, latency target ~300ms median during live windows, ~70 concurrent users.

marta (eng-infra): We can spin a short-run pool with on-demand burst. Proposal: reserve=5, burst_max=13, burst_policy=scheduled (1h blocks), autoscale_cooldown=4m. Need exact UTC windows + CIDR if peering. We'll create RBAC group for the demo.

li (eng-runtime): For 14b-quant at 1500 tokens, enable batching + KV prefix cache. Recommend fallback to 7b-quant if queue > 90s, and pin model to v1.4. Also enable token-cost tracing.

ana (security): For peering we require questionnaire + SOC contact; otherwise issue rotating key with 72h TTL and restrict to allowed referrer domain + IP list. Share questionnaire answers asap if peering.

omar (finance): Quick estimate: reserved 5 GPUs x 2 days + burst headroom -> rough $4k-$9k depending on actual burst hours. Approve provisional $2k buffer. Need confirmation to lock quote.

marta (eng-infra): CLI we'll use: 
``` 
rictl pool create \
  --name helio-shortrun \
  --reserved 5 \
  --burst-max 13 \
  --schedule "2026-07-08T14:00Z/2026-07-10T02:00Z" \
  --burst-windows "60m,60m" \
  --rbac "team:helio-poc" \
  --notes "short-run pool: rotating key + allowlist/peering pending"
```

ticket-bot: created INFRA-POC-5401 assigned to marta (eng-infra)

jess (sales): I'll get the CIDR and confirm windows today. Kai, please draft runbook & monitoring (latency/queue/token-cost). Marta, please provision after CIDR or allowlist received.

kai (solutions): Will do — include kill-switch and an ops contact.

omar (finance): Confirmed $2k buffer. Escalate if costs trend >$6k.

jess (sales): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
